subject: QA: zonoid — endpoints session_id contract: expects 400, daemon returns 409 (claim-gate residual)
description:
Repro: cd /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid && ./scripts/qa-suite.sh test/endpoints.test.js  (or `npm test`)

Reproducible failure (failed in full sweep + single-suite rerun on 2026-06-16, and in the 2026-06-15 run). 1 sub-test fails:

  test/endpoints.test.js:165 — "untested daemon endpoints"
  AssertionError: missing session_id when agent not in registry
  409 !== 400  (actual 409, expected 400)

Context: this is a RESIDUAL of last night's claim-gate group (QA problem d236bffd-.../1), which was CANCELED after the 12-suite fix 0b5a907e/5 ("Fix 12 pre-existing failing test suites — claim-gate contract drift") landed. That fix repaired 11 of the 12 suites (app-restart, dispatcher-model, filedrop-daemon, force-claim-cap, metric-branch-claim, newly-ready, phase2-integration, should-stop-advisory, touch-agent, unwired-quarantine all PASS now) but endpoints.test.js still asserts the OLD contract: it expects 400 for "missing session_id" but the daemon (per DG1, local/dg1) now returns 409 when the agent is not in the registry. Contract decision needed: is 400 or 409 correct when session_id is missing AND agent not registered? Fix = update the endpoints test assertion to match DG1's 409, OR adjust DG1 to return 400 for the missing-session_id case before the registry check. Suspect delta task: 0b5a907e-b58e-41cd-892b-4c0ca8d27099/5.
